services.title: Residential White-Glove Relocations
services.blurb: Single-residence and multi-residence moves throughout Manhattan, the Hamptons, and the tri-state, executed by W-2 crew under a single move manager. Custom crating for delicate furniture, climate-controlled transport, and a designed-not-improvised unpacking process. Doorman building protocols and COIs as standard.

services.title: Fine Art + Antiques Crating
services.blurb: Custom-built crating for paintings, sculpture, antique furniture, mirrors, and chandeliers. PACIN-credentialed art handlers, condition reports before and after, climate-controlled transit. We have moved Picassos, Steinways, and inherited Chippendale collections — and the photographs prove the same care across all three.

services.title: Estate-Wide Inventory + Cataloging
services.blurb: Complete estate cataloging for inheritance, insurance, divorce, or sale. Photographic record, condition assessment, valuation coordination with appraisers, and a digital catalog you can share with attorneys, accountants, or auction houses. Quietly the most-requested service for tri-state estate transitions.

services.title: Climate-Controlled Storage Vaults
services.blurb: Long-term and interim storage in our purpose-built tri-state vaults — temperature 65 to 72°F, humidity 45 to 55% RH, monitored continuously with logs available on request. Per-vault leasing rather than per-cubic-foot, so your inventory is not commingled with strangers' goods.

services.title: Designer + Interior-Trade Coordination
services.blurb: White-glove receiving for interior-design installations — designers ship furniture, art, and accessories to our climate-controlled facility for assembly, inspection, and coordinated install. Standard practice for $1M+ residential design projects in Manhattan and the Hamptons.

services.title: International Door-to-Door (Customs Managed)
services.blurb: FIDI / FAIM-accredited international relocations including customs brokerage, destination crew coordination, and home-search referrals. We have managed moves to and from London, Paris, Geneva, Tokyo, Singapore, Dubai, and São Paulo with single-point-of-contact management throughout.

process.title: Private estimate
process.blurb: In-home walk-through with a senior move manager. Written estimate within 48 hours, fixed-price for residential moves, time-and-materials only by mutual agreement on edge-case scope.

process.title: Move plan + COI
process.blurb: Detailed move plan, building protocol coordination, and certificate of insurance issued to your doorman building or HOA before the move date.

process.title: Day-of execution
process.blurb: W-2 crew under your dedicated move manager, custom crating where required, and a calm pace — never the panicked race a typical move becomes.

process.title: Settled-in walkthrough
process.blurb: We do not consider the move complete when the truck pulls away. We unpack designated rooms, place furniture per your floor plan, and walk through any post-move adjustments before billing closes.

faqs.q: Are crews W-2 employees or sub-contracted?
faqs.a: 100% W-2 employees, background-checked and trained on our internal protocols. We do not sub-contract crew. The customer service, the care, and the consistency we deliver depend on a stable workforce — sub-contracted labor cannot deliver this kind of move at this standard.

Full-replacement value coverage standard at $50/lb. Increased declared-value coverage available up to $5M per move. Released-value (the federally minimum 60 cents per pound) is available but actively discouraged — it does not actually cover the kind of inventory white-glove customers move.

faqs.q: Crating capability for art, mirrors, chandeliers, pianos?
faqs.a: Full custom crating for fine art, oversized mirrors, crystal chandeliers, and grand pianos including Steinway and Bösendorfer. Crates built in-house at our climate-controlled facility, condition reports before and after, and PACIN-credentialed handlers on every fine-art crew.

Temperature 65 to 72°F, humidity 45 to 55% relative humidity, continuously monitored with weekly logs available to clients on request. Independent vaults — your goods are not commingled with strangers' inventory. Leased per-vault rather than per-cubic-foot.

faqs.q: COI for doorman buildings (UES / Tribeca standard)?
faqs.a: Standard practice. Certificates of insurance issued to your specific building's name with the limits required by their move-in protocol — typically $1M to $5M general liability with the building named as additional insured. We do this dozens of times a week and know the language each building requires.

faqs.q: Dedicated move manager / single point of contact?
faqs.a: Yes — every white-glove engagement is assigned a senior move manager who is your single point of contact from estimate through post-move walkthrough. The move manager is on-site for the full move and personally responsible for any escalation — no call-center detour.

Yes. FIDI / FAIM-accredited for international relocations. We coordinate destination crew, customs brokerage, immigration consultation referrals, and post-arrival home-search support. Past international moves to London, Paris, Geneva, Tokyo, Singapore, Dubai, São Paulo — single-point-of-contact management throughout.

Standard. NDA available on request and routinely signed. Crew briefings on discretion expectations are part of high-profile-client protocol. We have moved C-suite executives, public-facing artists, and political families — nothing has appeared in any tabloid because the design is for it not to.
